# 宽公式

一行内引用 $\sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i} x_{i}^{2} + \sum_{j=1}^{m} b_{j} y_{j}^{2} = \int_{0}^{1} f(t)\,dt + \frac{\alpha+\beta}{\gamma+\delta} + \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i} x_{i}^{2} + \sum_{j=1}^{m} b_{j} y_{j}^{2} = \int_{0}^{1} f(t)\,dt + \frac{\alpha+\beta}{\gamma+\delta} + \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i} x_{i}^{2} + \sum_{j=1}^{m} b_{j} y_{j}^{2} = \int_{0}^{1} f(t)\,dt + \frac{\alpha+\beta}{\gamma+\delta}$ 三组求和后结束。

$$
\sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i} x_{i}^{2} + \sum_{j=1}^{m} b_{j} y_{j}^{2} = \int_{0}^{1} f(t)\,dt + \frac{\alpha+\beta}{\gamma+\delta} + \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i} x_{i}^{2} + \sum_{j=1}^{m} b_{j} y_{j}^{2} = \int_{0}^{1} f(t)\,dt + \frac{\alpha+\beta}{\gamma+\delta} + \frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x^{2}} + \sqrt{\alpha^{2}+\beta^{2}+\gamma^{2}+\delta^{2}}
$$

公式后说明完整。
